campaign.title: Exact mask, endpoint, and axial ownership identity

resource_policy.literature_policy: This is a finite contour and ownership round. Use exact Cauchy--Green, endpoint Cauchy, and vector-residue algebra. Search primary literature only if a specifically named several-variable residue or Cauchy--Pompeiu identity becomes necessary; no black-box theorem may replace the finite sign and corner ledger.

frozen_target.question: For the hierarchical beta mask at finite U,V,S, does endpoint collapse followed by finite v-axis displacement give exactly the same boundary, arithmetic, axial, connector, and corner ownership as performing those operations before masking, so that the residual terminal share has E_own=0?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Write one mask-by-mask identity for the beta terminal vertical plus its Cauchy--Green area connector. It must route T_xi+S_xi+P_xi=D_xi-A_xi, the cancelling artificial R1 residue, the recombined R1 arithmetic residue, the v=0 vector residue on every contour stratum, the u=0 share, the joint corner, and both finite height connectors exactly once. Prove E_own=H_G-H_E1-H_R1=0 for the endpoint-free residual, or isolate the first explicit nonzero masked boundary operator. No terminal symbol estimate is part of this round.
quantities: hierarchical mask Theta_beta=psi(beta) and its one-edge Cauchy--Green connector
G=E1+R1 artificial-pole cancellation under the same mask
full versus masked A=0 arithmetic residue share
terminal, radial-side, and arithmetic v=0 vector residues
u=0 axial share and joint u=v=0 corner
endpoint stars, profiles, floors, and external X^(1/4) normalization
rho ownership defect E_own and its physical L derivative

completion_criteria: The hierarchical beta mask convention is frozen and distinguished from the disjoint two-edge mask.
One exact finite contour identity lists every endpoint, artificial, arithmetic, v=0, u=0, corner, side, and connector term with orientation.
The accepted endpoint and arithmetic modules are invoked only after exact mask recombination; no unmasked estimate is applied to an isolated masked share.
E_own=0 and its physical L derivative are proved for the endpoint-free terminal remainder, or the first explicit surviving operator is isolated.
A blind derivation and hostile seam audit independently assess the identity.
The conductor closes the round before opening the axial-subtracted symbol estimate.

tasks.target: Independently derive the finite mask-by-mask compatibility identity for the hierarchical beta mask Theta_beta=psi(beta). Start from the accepted finite vector kernel, endpoint Cauchy identity, and one-edge Cauchy--Green formula. List terminal, radial-side, arithmetic, v=0, u=0, joint-corner, and finite-height connector shares with signs. Decide whether the endpoint-free residual has E_own=0; if the permitted statements do not define a needed share, isolate the first exact missing coefficient. Do not read any Round-33 claimant report.
required_output: Exact finite compatibility identity or first definition obstruction
Complete orientation and one-count residue ledger
Seven-section report at the assigned path

tasks.target: Construct the exact commuting diagram between hierarchical beta masking, Cauchy--Green displacement, M=1 endpoint collapse, and finite v-axis displacement. Recombine complementary mask and connector shares before invoking proved unmasked endpoint/arithmetic modules. Prove E_own=0 for the side-collapsed endpoint-free terminal operator, or write the smallest explicit masked boundary/axial survivor including its normalization and dependencies.
required_output: Exact commuting identity or smallest explicit survivor
Mask, endpoint, axial, connector, corner, and normalization ledger

Check Cauchy--Green signs, the full-versus-filtered A=0 residue, artificial-pole cancellation, endpoint Cauchy orientations, whether v=0 extraction commutes with the beta mask, u=0 and corner inclusion-exclusion, finite connector ownership, and the physical endpoint-limit scope.
